sql: SELECT r.pmid, r.pmcid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*29[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '22180633' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%29%' LIMIT 5
rows: Changes in lipoprotein subfraction concentration and composition in healthy individuals treated with the CETP inhibitor anacetrapib.
ANA 150 mg/day versus placebo resulted in significant decreases in LDL-cholesterol (26%) and apo B (29%) and increases in HDL-cholesterol (82%)
